name: foodhealthco-ndo-ops
description: Run nutrition-data-ops scoring/tagging/ingestion operations (FHS scoring, Text2Tag, profile backfills, score approvals, client publishing) plus catalogued read-only NDO lookups (ndo-query: score status, approval queue, publish backlog) that run as the operator's own IAM identity against the curated dietitian view schema. Ops wrap 19 manage.py commands with CSV-upload, env translation, prod confirmation, and per-command preflight read-outs.
